name: FlowForge
notes:
## New
- **AI Story Shorts – Daily** template (Templates → Content): turns a trending topic into a YouTube Short every evening.
  - Publishes automatically: scheduled for 20:00 India time by default (or public right away, or Private), set in "Publish Settings".
  - Safety gate: only a first-try approval with every quality score 8+ is published; anything else stays Private for review.
  - If the editor rejects the first story, the writer gets one more try with the feedback.
  - After the upload it checks the video's status on YouTube and emails you about any problem (rejected, failed, or locked as private).
- New nodes: **RSS Read**, **Google Sheets** (get rows, append row), **YouTube** (upload video, with publish time and AI-content disclosure), **Gmail** (send), **Basic LLM Chain** (Google Gemini, with JSON output).
- New credentials: YouTube, Google Sheets and Gmail (just a client ID and secret) and Google Gemini (PaLM) API.
- HTTP Request: "Predefined Credential Type" sign-in.
- "Use template" picks your existing credentials and tells you which ones are missing.
- Download page: an "All files" list with every app, on any device.

### Install
- **Windows:** FlowForge-Setup.exe
- **Android:** FlowForge.apk (allow installing apps from your browser)
- **iPhone:** FlowForge.ipa - unsigned, install with AltStore or Sideloadly
